context: Analyze this legacy 1970s mainframe COBOL security snippet. It implements user authentication against a sequential master file (SYS1.USER.MAST) and access control for data files. Key security concerns: plaintext password storage, no encryption/decryption routines, sequential file I/O (slow for large datasets), and basic equality checks only. Evaluate the security vulnerabilities, suggest modernization paths (e.g., VSAM/DB2 integration), and identify compliance gaps for PCI-DSS or HIPAA if ported to modern systems.
